notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing itself and any other creature you control, targeting Body Double.
Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating at least one 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Whisper ability, returning Body Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Whisper.
Activate Body Double by tapping it, sacrificing itself and the Zombie token, targeting Whisper.
Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Body Double ability, returning Whisper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
